headline: AI Agents Outnumber Humans in Economy, Predicts Coinbase CEO
summary: Coinbase CEO Brian Armstrong forecasts that the agentic economy, driven by AI agents, will surpass the human economy in size, signaling a significant shift in the labor market and economic structure. This prediction is gaining traction as AI capabilities continue to expand.
whyItMatters: It highlights the rapidly evolving role of AI in the economy and underscores the need for workforce adaptation and policy adjustments.
